stories.headline: X Money Wants to Make the Feed a Financial Front Door
stories.body: Digital wallets have made the phone a familiar place to pay. X Money is testing whether a social platform can claim a place in that payment routine. stories.headline: Bank of America places new restriction on remote work
stories.body: In the latest example of lenders rolling back their hybrid work policies, the nation's second-largest bank will soon require its employees to choose nonconsecutive days to work from home.
